Changes in the methodology by which RealClearPolling calculates its average will have no bearing on the resolution of this market.\\n\\nIn case of obvious data integrity issues (i.e., erroneous data), the market may remain open until the end of the third calendar day (ET) after the date on which such data is first released to allow for corrections.
